```{r include=FALSE}

library(readr)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")

save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_micro/outputs/final/OMIE'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

```



```{r}

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(first_stage_data)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(first_stage_data))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables")

first_stage_data[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(first_stage_data[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))


#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         # Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         # Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity
         )%>% 
  rename(day_ahead_renewable_forecast= day_ahead_forecast)

# Créer une variable factorielle pour clusteriser
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  mutate(cluster_var = interaction(auction_date_plus_one, auction))

non_finite_rows <- first_stage_data %>%
  filter(!is.finite(log_price_diff) | !is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))

first_stage_data_clean$weekday <- weekdays(first_stage_data_clean$delivery_date) 

#pour les renewables comme on ne sait pas vraiment quand sera publiée la 2ème 
#prédiction, on prend entre la première et la dernière price_diff

# first_stage_renewable <- first_stage_data_clean  %>% 
#   filter(auction_before!= auction_after) %>% 
#   filter(auction_before == 4 | auction_before == 5)


first_stage_renewable <- first_stage_data_clean %>%
  filter(auction_before >= 1) %>%
  group_by(auction_date_plus_one, creneau) %>%
  summarise(
    # Aggregate over auction_before 1 to 5
    price_diff_1to5 = sum(price_diff[auction_before >= 1 & auction_before <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    log_price_diff_1to5 = sum(log_price_diff[auction_before >= 1 & auction_before <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Separate variable for auction_before == 6
    price_diff_6 = sum(price_diff[auction_before == 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    log_price_diff_6 = sum(log_price_diff[auction_before == 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    # Count auctions
    number_auctions = n(),
    
    # For all other columns, take the first value (excluding those already handled)
    across(
      .cols = !any_of(c("price_diff", "log_price_diff")),
      .fns = ~ first(.x)
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )%>% 
  arrange(auction_date_plus_one, as.numeric(creneau))


colnames(first_stage_renewable)

```

On s'occupe maintenant de regarder le intraday update


```{r}


m_control_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff_1to5 ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast+   gen_tot+
    temperature_demand + precipitation_demand+ relative_humidity_demand+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau)+ as.factor(number_auctions) ,
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_renew, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_renew <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

m_control_renew_6 <- lm(
  log_price_diff_6 ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast+   gen_tot+
    temperature_demand + precipitation_demand+ relative_humidity_demand+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) +as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau)+ as.factor(number_auctions) ,
  data= first_stage_renewable)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_control_renew_6, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ creneau)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_renew_6 <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```

Intraday forecast at 8.00: at least one update to be published at 8.00 Brussels time on the day of actual delivery for intra-day. This value is the most recent forecast at 8:00 the day of delivery

```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_control_renew, m_control_renew_6, 
                       #m_renew_plant, 
    type = "html",
    #se = list(NULL, NULL, cl_se_renew_plant),
    se = list(cl_se_control_renew, cl_se_control_renew_6),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Capacity', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity', "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity",'gen_tot',
             "intraday_update_renewables" , "unpredicted_renewables", "wind_solar_tot",
             "Published.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "day_ahead_renewable_forecast")
 )
```



```{r}

# Cluster by creneau, HAC structure over time within that cluster


# Model for 1–5 horizon
m_control_renew_fe <- feols(
  log_price_diff_1to5 ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast + gen_tot +
    temperature_demand + precipitation_demand + relative_humidity_demand +
    factor(year) + factor(month) + factor(weekday) +
    factor(creneau) + factor(number_auctions),
  data = first_stage_renewable,
  panel.id = ~ datetime,
  cluster = ~ creneau
  )


# Model for horizon 6


m_control_renew_6_fe <- feols(
  log_price_diff_6 ~ intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast + gen_tot +
    temperature_demand + precipitation_demand + relative_humidity_demand +
    factor(year) + factor(month) + factor(weekday) +
    factor(creneau) + factor(number_auctions),
  data = first_stage_renewable,
  panel.id = ~ datetime,
  cluster = ~ creneau
  )


summary(m_control_renew_fe)  # Default Newey-West
# 
summary(m_control_renew_6_fe)


```








Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le modèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+
    #+Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity 
    +gen_tot+temperature_demand + precipitation_demand+ relative_humidity_demand+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + as.factor(auction_before)+
    intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast,
  data= first_stage_data_clean)

vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_cl <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real, type = "HC0")
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_hc <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))





```

```{r}


# perform first stage regression
m_basic_all <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Capacity +Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity 
  #+ Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity 
  + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity+ Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity 
  #+ Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity 
  + gen_tot+temperature_demand + precipitation_demand+ relative_humidity_demand+
    intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables +
    day_ahead_renewable_forecast+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month)+ as.factor(weekday)+
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_basic_all, type = "HC0")
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_hc <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_basic_all, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_cl <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))




```


```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer( m_basic_all, m_real,
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic_cl, cl_se_real_cl),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Predicted", "Limiting", "Limiting ClSD"),
    keep = c('Capacity')
)
 
```
